subject: What grade of sorcerer is Gojo?

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text: Overall Skill Level: Despite not possessing an innate technique, Kusakabe is a respected grade 1 sorcerer and a master swordsman of the New Shadow Style. Mei Mei regarded Kusakabe as the only sorcerer of his grade to make that rank without an innate technique.(Chapter 88, Episode 32) According to her, Kento Nanami and Gojo, Kusakabe is the strongest grade 1 sorcerer, though Gojo specified that this statement may not be accurate if sorcerers from the Big Three Families were to be taken into account.(Chapter 253)

beats.title: Summary
beats.text: Satoru Gojo comes under sudden attack from the special grade cursed spirit, Jogo. They trade attacks, but Gojo proves why he's the self-proclaimed strongest jujutsu sorcerer. After effortlessly outclassing his opponent, Satoru brings Yuji and uses the exchange as a learning experience for his young protégé.

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: At the same time, Ijichi meets with Gojo to apologize for allowing someone else to cast another curtain on top of his barrier. This is what trapped the students inside with an unidentified semi-grade 1 curse that wasn't apart of the original mission. Gojo doesn't blame Ijichi because their enemy is strong. He is one of the four special grade sorcerers and the very worst of all curse users: Suguru Geto.

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Team Nanami finds Yuji on the roof and Megumi gets him to stop yelling. Mechamaru confirms the exact details of the situation to them and proposes that the teams of sorcerers attack the Gojo's location from the adjacent subway stations. This would require them to take down the curtain barring sorcerers first. Nanami tells the trio to take down the curtain while he meets up with Ijichi to handle some logistical stuff only grade 1 sorcerers can handle. Before leaving, Nanami tells Ino that he's leaving Yuji and Megumi in his care. Moved that Nanami has put his faith in him, Ino emphatically explains what will happen if Gojo isn't freed. Jujutsu sorcerers will squabble over the fall of the Gojo clan and then the forces of evil will take advantage. If this happens, even Yuji and Megumi know that the age of humans will end in Japan. Confident that the boys understand the stakes, Ino slaps them on the back and says it's time to move out. He swears that they'll take down the curtain before Nanami gets back and confidently adds that they'll rescue Satoru Gojo no matter what.

beats.title: Abilities and Powers / Overview
beats.text: Overall Skill Level: Nanami is a model example of what a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer should be. Yuji and Takuma Ino both look up to Nanami for his demeanor when actively approaching a difficult situation as well as his incredible skill when it comes down to solving it. Satoru Gojo entrusted Nanami with looking after Yuji due to these traits as well(Chapter 19, Episode 9) and it paid off well for Yuji's growth.(Chapter 31, Episode 13) Ino, a powerful grade 2 sorcerer, approaches every tough decision with "what would Nanami do" in mind because he believes Nanami always handles things the right way.(Chapter 95, Episode 35)

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Nearing victory, Kenjaku boasts that for a sorcerer, the rank of special grade signifies the power to overthrow nations. This is obviously true for Satoru Gojo, but Suguru Geto's Cursed Spirit Manipulation can command an army of demons. Weak curses can be reinforced with cursed energy and overwhelm fighters of even Choso's caliber.

beats.title: Synopsis / Shibuya Incident Arc
beats.text: When Kento Nanami arrived at the scene, Shigemo attempted to hold Akari hostage, but realized too late that she escaped by crawling up an escalator during the confusion.(Chapter 100, Episode 36) After the grade 1 sorcerer defeated Shigemo, Akari and Nobara listened as he told them that Ijichi was alive and Satoru Gojo was sealed. Nanami then ordered the women to stay and wait for rescue.(Chapter 101, Episode 36) At 11:14 P.M., a paramedic team came to provide aid for the two. Against Akari's pleas, Nobara left her with the paramedics for treatment before rejoining the battle inside the curtain.(Chapter 123, Episode 43)

beats.title: Cursed Child Arc
beats.text: Three months later, Yuta is training with Maki as Panda, Toge, and Gojo watch. Gojo assigns a mission to Toge which Yuta will accompany him. Yuta was also told by Panda that Toge was the only grade 2 of the first year and was given solo misssions. Gojo then explains what Toge's ability is and that Yuta is to observe Toge without bringing out Rika.
